guidance.promptSnippet: Ask {{name}} one question when you genuinely need their decision
promptGuidelines: Ask exactly one question per ask_user_question call, and only for a decision that is genuinely {{name}}'s (product behaviour, priorities, anything that changes what was agreed). Decide everything else yourself.
{{name}} often sees only the dialog. Put the context inside the question itself: in plain words, what this is about, why it matters now, and what each option leads to.
Options are 2-4 real choices drawn from what {{name}} has asked for. Don't add recommendation labels. If you lean one way, say so in the question's text in one sentence.
